selector.rationale: Kimura disease best explains the clinical findings of a gradually enlarging swelling of the cheek with lymphoid hyperplasia and adjacent bony destruction, supported by notes AX_SE001 and AX_ME007

rejected.label: Myositis
rejected.why: although myositis is mentioned in the biopsy, Kimura disease better explains the overall clinical picture

rejected.label: IgG4-related disease
rejected.why: lack of specific evidence supporting IgG4-related disease

rejected.label: Sjögren's syndrome
rejected.why: Sjögren's syndrome does not typically present with a large cheek swelling or lymphoid hyperplasia

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: while lymphoma is a consideration, Kimura disease is more specific and better supported by the evidence
